changeSet.author: landvault
changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE estate_payment_plans; ALTER TABLE estates DROP COLUMN payment_plans_version;

changeSet.author: landvault
changeSet.sql:
CREATE VIEW marketplace_payment_plans WITH (security_barrier = true) AS SELECT p.id AS plan_id, p.estate_id AS estate_id, p.sort_order AS sort_order, p.name AS name, p.deposit_pct AS deposit_pct, p.deposit_amount AS deposit_amount, p.instalment_count AS instalment_count, p.frequency AS frequency, p.premium_pct AS premium_pct FROM estate_payment_plans p JOIN estates e ON e.id = p.estate_id JOIN marketplace_estate_eligibility el ON el.estate_id = p.estate_id AND el.eligible WHERE p.deleted = false AND p.version = e.payment_plans_version;
REVOKE ALL ON marketplace_payment_plans FROM PUBLIC; REVOKE ALL ON marketplace_payment_plans FROM ${appDbUsername}; GRANT SELECT ON marketplace_payment_plans TO ${appDbUsername};
